title: Tool Call Firewall
tagline: Authorize structured tool requests before they cross a side-effect boundary.
summary: Build a deny-by-default policy evaluator with bounded arguments, role permissions, single-use approvals and a structured audit log. The artifact is a library gate; applications must place it before every real tool execution.
usefulFor: An approval receipt proving exactly which operation was authorized and executed.
The native CLI requires a trusted role from the invoking application.
youWillBuild: An approval receipt proving exactly which operation was authorized and executed.

stages.title: Validate an unambiguous call envelope
stages.summary: Parse a bounded four-field envelope using a pipe delimiter for this local exercise.

stages.title: Evaluate role and path policy
stages.summary: Only reader and editor roles exist.

stages.title: Consume a request-bound approval once
stages.summary: An approval is bound to the complete call identity supplied by a trusted application and is consumed only for an approval-required decision.

stages.title: Record bounded audit evidence
stages.summary: Format a stable tab-separated audit row after the policy decision.
